subject: Onsite travel: delegate leg consolidation and booking instructions
messages:
From: Devon Simmons <devon.simmons@acme.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: bookings@aldatravel.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onsite — potential leg merges for Marissa/Ben

Irene — thanks for the heads up on the headcount change for the Redwood exec day. We reviewed the original routing and have two possible ways to consolidate Marissa and Ben onto more efficient legs before the onsite:

Option A — both on same morning connection (1 stop): arrival 09:10 local; total travel ~6h; higher fare but single connection.
Option B — split leg where Ben takes a late-evening redeye and Marissa takes a midnight connection; arrival window 07:30–09:30 local; lower fare but one passenger has a longer layover.

Attached is a proposed itinerary (proposed-itinerary-v2.pdf) with PNRs masked. Before I lock anything in I need:
- official traveler names as they appear on passports/IDs
- seat preferences (aisle/window)
- whether Redwood pays for advance seat selection or we bill to Acme

If you confirm by EOD we can issue tickets with the vendor fares in fare-options.xls and honor the refundable window.

Best,
Devon
Devon Simmons
Acme Travel Desk
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Devon Simmons <devon.simmons@acme.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, bookings@aldatravel.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite — potential leg merges for Marissa/Ben

Devon — thanks. Attaching the delegate list (redwood-delegate-list.csv) with passport name formats. Quick answers below:

- Travelers: Marissa Cole (Marissa Cole) / Ben Carter (Benjamin Carter)
- Seats: Marissa prefers window; Ben prefers aisle
- Redwood will cover advance seat selection for both (charge to corporate account)

Constraints:
- Arrival SLO: team must be on site no later than 10:00 — earlier preferred for AV/run-through.
- Ben has a meeting the evening before in SF; if he does a redeye he needs guaranteed checked baggage and a confirmed arrival slot with 60 min buffer.

If option B (split legs) results in Ben arriving after 10:00 we need to avoid it. Please confirm ETA ranges for both options and the delta in total ticket cost (seats + any change fees). Also copy Laura Bennett from People Operations — she will confirm per-diem and ground transfers once we lock flights.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: bookings@aldatravel.com <bookings@aldatravel.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite — potential leg merges for Marissa/Ben

Hi Irene / team — forwarding two clean fare options per Devon's note (fare-options.xls attached). Summary: 

- Option A (1-stop, both on same connection) — ETA 09:05; total fare per pax $612; includes one carry-on + standard refund window; seats available (Marissa window, Ben aisle) for $25 each.
- Option B (split: Marissa midnight connection; Ben redeye) — ETA Marissa 07:40 / Ben 09:45; total fare per pax $498; Ben's arrival at 09:45 exceeds the 10:00 SLO but he would hit your 60-min buffer if he clears customs quickly. Checked bag is included on both fares.

Notes: Option B saves cost but pushes Ben close to your stated deadline. We can hold Option A until 11:59 PM tonight; after that fares may change.

Attachments: fare-options.xls

Let us know which to ticket and we will issue e-tickets + share PNRs.

— Alda Travel Co. bookings@aldatravel.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite — potential leg merges for Marissa/Ben

Irene — I reviewed both options. I prefer Option B (midnight connection) because it gets me in earlier for the morning run-through and I can handle the short layover. Ben — do you mind the later arrival? If not, I’m fine to go with Option A to keep things simple.
